errors.evidence: The description fails to mention one of the text annotations present in the chart: 'Deutliche Herabsetzung der chinesischen Exportquoten'.
The description incorrectly states that the lines have markers (e.g., 'Kreis-Markierungen', 'Quadrat-Markierungen'). The lines in the chart are solid lines without any markers.
The description states the price of Cer (Oxid) rises to about 30 USD/kg in 2022, but the green line on the chart is close to 0 USD/kg at that time.
The description states the price of Neodym (Oxid) peaked at over 150 USD/kg in 2011, but the chart shows its peak was approximately 350 USD/kg.
The description states the price of Lanthan (Oxid) rises to about 60 USD/kg in 2022, but the chart shows it is only around 10-15 USD/kg.
The description states the price of Praseodym (Oxid) peaked at over 150 USD/kg in 2011, but the chart shows its peak was approximately 250 USD/kg.
The description states the price of PrNd Mischmetall peaked at over 200 USD/kg in 2011, but the chart shows its peak was approximately 360 USD/kg.

errors.text_span: Terbium (Oxid), grau mit Quadrat-Markierungen, beginnt bei ca. 50 US-Dollar/kg, steigt 2011 auf über 400 US-Dollar/kg, fällt bis 2016 auf ca. 50 US-Dollar/kg und steigt 2022 auf ca. 200 US-Dollar/kg.
errors.evidence: The description reads the values for Terbium (Oxid) from the left y-axis, but the chart specifies that Terbium uses the right y-axis (scale 0-4,500). For example, it states the 2011 peak is over 400 USD/kg, when it is actually over 4,000 USD/kg.
